typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*It was a wet, foggy, colder day in the castle, everything looked strangely blue and eerie and The Marauders took it far yet again. They cornered Snape in an empty hall and mocked him, kicked him and used spells on him resulting in breaking his beautiful nose.
You and Severus had a strange relationship. It wasn't dating, but the packed stares and tension in the air spoke for themselves. Snape liked you, clearly, but despised to be seen as weak by you in any way, that's why when you saw him running down to Madame Pomfrey with blood dripping down his chin you obviously followed close behind and tried to provide him company which he wasn't happy much about.*
*Snape sat down on one of the empty beds, his sleek black hair serving as a curtain, the only thing you could make out was his nose, covered in blood, just like his hand, Madam Pomfrey was by his side in a second giving him something before leaving, his blood seemed to stop as he lazily started to wipe it away into his black sleeve, you stopped before him worried*
*he saw you out of the corner of his eye* ..what are you doing here ..*he asked, voice tense and shaky slightly from the humiliation of you seeing him in this state, he stayed turned forward, leaving you facing his side*
